questions.q: Taking pictures ____ very interesting.
questions.zh: 攝影是非常有趣的事。
questions.explain: 動名詞作主詞，用單數形動詞（is/was/has/Vs/es）。

questions.q: ____ the bad news made him cry.
questions.zh: 聽到這個壞消息，他哭了。
questions.explain: 動詞放在主詞的位置，應改為動名詞。

questions.q: ____ a desert has always been a risk adventure.
questions.zh: 橫越沙漠，一直是一項很冒險的探險行動。
questions.explain: 動名詞作主詞，接單數形動詞。

questions.q: Before he came, I'd finished ____ the whole book.
questions.zh: 在他來到之前，我已讀完整本書了。
questions.explain: finish + V-ing（完成⋯）。

questions.q: I always enjoy ____ to popular music at night.
questions.zh: 我喜歡晚上聽聽流行音樂。
questions.explain: enjoy + V-ing（喜歡；享受⋯）。

questions.q: We are considering ____ a trip around the island.
questions.zh: 我們正考慮作環島旅行。
questions.explain: consider + V-ing（考慮）。

questions.q: I hope you don't mind ____ at your newspaper.
questions.zh: 我希望你不介意我看你的報紙。
questions.explain: mind 的後面可接 (one's) + V-ing 或 if S + V。

questions.q: When a man's heart stops ____, he dies.
questions.zh: 一個人的心臟停止跳動時，他就死了。
questions.explain: stop beating（停止跳動）。

questions.q: I can't help ____ he is still alive.
questions.zh: 我不得不認為他仍然活著。
questions.explain: can't help + V-ing = can't but + 原形 V（不得不；禁不住）。

questions.q: So far as I am concerned, I prefer reading ____.
questions.zh: 就我而言，我較喜歡讀書，而不喜歡喝酒。
questions.explain:
① prefer V-ing + to V-ing（較喜歡⋯而不喜歡）
② would rather + 原形 V than + 原形 V（寧願⋯而不願）

questions.q: It goes without ____ that knowledge is important.
questions.zh: 知識很重要是不用說的。
questions.explain:
It goes without saying that + S + V（不用說；自不待言）
= It is needless to say that + S + V
= Needless to say, S + V

questions.q: We are looking forward ____ our friends next week.
questions.zh: 我們期盼下星期見到我們的朋友。
questions.explain:
look forward to + V-ing（期待；期望）
= expect to + 原形 V

questions.q: He spent a lot of money ____ books and magazines.
questions.zh: 他花了很多錢買書和雜誌。
questions.explain: 人 + spend + 金錢 + V-ing / on + N。

questions.q: The silkworm is an insect worth ____.
questions.zh: 蠶是一種值得去了解的昆蟲。
questions.explain: be worth + V-ing（值得⋯）。

questions.q: She went out without ____ good-bye to us.
questions.zh: 她沒有向我們道別就走了。
questions.explain:
① S + V... without + 名詞/V-ing（沒有⋯就⋯）
② say good-bye (good morning...) to(人)：向(人)說再見(早安)

questions.q: The curious student kept on ____ questions.
questions.zh: 這位好奇的學生不斷地提問題。
questions.explain: keep on + V-ing（繼續⋯）。

questions.q: He is such a strange person; there's ____ what he'll do next.
questions.zh: 他為人怪異，我們無法知道他下回要做什麼事。
questions.explain: There is no knowing = It is impossible to know（無法知道）= No one knows。

questions.q: When she heard the bad news, she burst ____.
questions.zh: 當她聽到這個壞消息時，她突然大哭起來。
questions.explain: burst out crying = burst into tears（突然大哭）。

questions.q: You must never cross the street without ____ the light to turn green.
questions.zh: 你要等到紅燈轉成綠燈時才可以過馬路。
questions.explain: never... without + V-ing（每⋯必定；無⋯而不會）= never... but + V。

questions.q: Scientists succeed ____ protein out of old newspapers.
questions.zh: 科學家很成功地用舊報紙製造出蛋白質。
questions.explain:
① succeed in + V-ing（成功）；fail in + V-ing（失敗）
② protein [ˈproʊtiːn] 名 蛋白質

questions.q: He wrote letter after letter, and it was well past midnight when he finished ____ the last one.
questions.zh: 他一封信接著一封信寫，當他寫完最後一封時，已經超過午夜時分了。
questions.explain: finish + V-ing（完成）。

questions.q: None of us objected to ____ George to the birthday party.
questions.zh: 我們之中沒有人反對邀請喬治參加生日宴會。
questions.explain: object to + V-ing（反對）= be opposed to + V-ing。

questions.q: To our surprise, he escaped ____ in the accident.
questions.zh: 令我們驚訝的是，他在意外中未受到傷害。
questions.explain:
① escape + V-ing（逃避；躲過）
② 受到傷害應用被動 being hurt。

questions.q: I remember ____ the house about an hour ago.
questions.zh: 我記得一小時前看見他離開房子。
questions.explain:
① remember + V-ing（記得做過⋯事情）
② see + 人 + leave（看到人離開）

questions.q: ____ going to the movies tonight?
questions.zh: 今晚去看場電影如何？
questions.explain:
How about = What about + V-ing（⋯如何？）
Would you like to + 原形 V（要不要⋯？）
Would you please + 原形 V（請你⋯好嗎？）
I don't mind + V-ing（我不介意⋯）

questions.q: Whatever Mr. Brown does, he does it with an eye to ____ more money.
questions.zh: 無論布朗先生做什麼，其目的是要賺更多的錢。
questions.explain: with an eye to + V-ing（為了）= with a view to + V-ing。

questions.q: You'll soon get used to ____ early morning walks. It does wonderful things to your health.
questions.zh: 不久你將習慣晨間散步，它對於你健康有奇妙的效果。
questions.explain: get used to + N/V-ing（習慣於）。

questions.q: He stopped me from telling her the secret by ____.
options: putting his finger to his lips
questions.zh: 他用手指擱在嘴唇上來制止我向她說出秘密。
questions.explain: put one's finger to one's lips（把手指擱在嘴唇上）〔意圖叫人沉默〕。

questions.q: When you find something in your writing that needs ____, you should mark it on the paper.
questions.zh: 當你發現你的文章需要修改，你應該在紙上做記號。
questions.explain: 主詞 + need + V-ing（需要⋯）= 主詞 + need + to be p.p.。

questions.q: ____ is extremely dangerous.
options: Cars at very high speeds driving
At very high speeds driving cars
Cars driving at very high speeds
Driving cars at very high speeds
questions.zh: 開快車是十分危險的。
questions.explain:
① Driving cars... is...（動名詞作主詞）
② at very high speeds（以高速度）

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 根據中文提示，在空格內填入適當的字詞完成句子

questions.q:
離開之前記得打電話給我。
Remember ____ ____ me a call before you leave.
questions.zh: 離開之前記得打電話給我。
questions.explain:
① remember to + V（記得要做⋯事情）／ remember V-ing（記得已做過⋯事情）
② give(人) a call = call(人) up / give(人) a ring = ring(人) up（打電話給某人）

questions.q:
請你把這封信替我寄了，你不在意吧？
You ____ ____ this letter for me, would you?
questions.zh: 請你把這封信替我寄了，你不在意吧？
questions.explain: Do/Would you mind + V-ing / one's + V-ing / if + S + V ?（你介意⋯嗎？）

questions.q:
他費了一整天打掃房子。
He ____ a whole day ____ the house up.
questions.zh: 他費了一整天打掃房子。
questions.explain:
表示「花費時間」之句型：
① It / 事 + takes + (人) + 時間 + to V
② 人 + spend + 時間 + V-ing

questions.q:
地震是無法預測的。
There is ____ ____ an earthquake.
questions.zh: 地震是無法預測的。
questions.explain:
「不可能；無法」之句型：
There is no + V-ing = It is impossible to + V = No one can + 原形 V

questions.q:
這一篇文章值得仔細閱讀。
The article is ____ ____ carefully.
questions.zh: 這一篇文章值得仔細閱讀。
questions.explain:
「值得」之句型：
① 事物 + be worth + V-ing
② It pays to + V
③ It is worth while + to V (或 V-ing)

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 將下列中文句子翻譯成英文

questions.q: 很多高中生期待進大學就讀。
answer: Many high school students are looking forward to going to college.
questions.explain: look forward to + V-ing = expect to + V（期望）

questions.q: 因此他們致力於學問的追求。
answer: Therefore, they devote themselves to pursuing learning.
Therefore, they dedicate themselves to pursuing learning.
Therefore, they are devoted to pursuing learning.
Therefore, they are dedicated to pursuing learning.
questions.explain: devote / dedicate oneself to + V-ing / N = be devoted / dedicated to + V-ing / N（專心致力於⋯）

questions.q: 有些學生習慣於開夜車讀書。
answer: Some students are used to sitting up late to study.
Some students get used to burning the midnight oil to study.
questions.explain: be / get used to + V-ing / N = be / get accustomed to + V-ing / N = make it a rule to + 原形 V（習慣於⋯）

questions.q: 父母親應阻止他們這樣做。
answer: Their parents should stop them from doing so.
Their parents should prevent them from doing so.
questions.explain: stop / prevent / keep... from + V-ing / N（阻止⋯使不能⋯）

questions.q: 畢竟，對他們而言，健康是勝過一切的。
answer: After all, health is above everything for them.
After all, health is the most important thing for them.
questions.explain: after all（畢竟）

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions:
閱讀短文並選出最適當的答案：

Many countries are experiencing difficult problems in desert areas. Poor land is farmed until it __1.__ and trees are cut for firewood, __2.__ the soil against wind and rain.
Scientists do not understand all the problems of the deserts, but there have been many ideas for __3.__ the land. Saudi Arabia has planted 10 million trees __4.__ the sand from __5.__ fertile areas.
The spread of the deserts affects most countries. The big question today is how can an __6.__ world population find food and space without __7.__ the land it lives on. For many countries, __8.__ the desert is the only chance __9.__ starvation, destruction, __10.__ disaster.

【詞彙及片語提示】
1. experience 動 經歷過
2. in desert areas: 沙漠地區
3. is farmed: 被耕作
4. firewood 名 劈柴
5. soil 名 土壤
6. against wind and rain: 受風吹雨打
7. scientist 名 科學家
8. Saudi Arabia: 沙烏地阿拉伯
9. fertile areas: 土壤肥沃區
10. spread 名 擴大；擴張
11. affect 動 影響
12. world population: 世界人口
13. starvation 名 飢餓
14. destruction 名 破壞
15. disaster 名 災難；不幸

questions.q: Poor land is farmed until it ____ and trees are cut for firewood...
questions.zh: 貧瘠的土地被過度耕種直到耗竭為止...
questions.explain: be worn out（枯竭；穿破；耗盡）

questions.q: ...and trees are cut for firewood, ____ the soil against wind and rain.
questions.zh: ...樹木被砍來當柴燒，使土壤直接受到風吹雨打。
questions.explain: ...and trees are cut for firewood, and left the soil... = ...and trees are cut for firewood, leaving the soil...

questions.q: Scientists do not understand all the problems of the deserts, but there have been many ideas for ____ the land.
questions.zh: 科學家們尚未完全了解沙漠的所有問題，但已有許多解救土地的想法。
questions.explain:
① save 動 解救
② safe 名 保險箱

questions.q: Saudi Arabia has planted 10 million trees ____ the sand from fertile areas.
questions.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯種植了一千萬棵樹以幫助阻止沙子...
questions.explain:
① ...planted 10 million trees (in order) to help (to) keep...
② help 之後用 to V 或原形 V 均可。

questions.q: ...to help keep the sand from ____ fertile areas.
questions.zh: ...阻止沙子吞沒肥沃的地區。
questions.explain:
① keep... from + V-ing（阻止⋯使不致於⋯）
② take over（接管；接收；吞沒／取而代之）
③ take off（脫去；起飛）

questions.q: The big question today is how can an ____ world population find food and space...
questions.zh: 今日重大的問題是，持續膨脹的世界人口該如何找到食物與空間...
questions.explain: expanding 形 擴大的；膨脹的

questions.q: ...without ____ the land it lives on.
questions.zh: ...而不破壞賴以生存的土地。
questions.explain:
① without destroying the land（而不會破壞土地）
② 動名詞（destroying）之後尚可接受詞，而名詞（destruction）之後則不可再接名詞。

questions.q: For many countries, ____ the desert is the only chance...
questions.zh: 對許多國家而言，與沙漠搏鬥是唯一的機會...
questions.explain: battling the desert（與沙漠搏鬥），動名詞作主詞。

questions.q: ...the only chance ____ starvation, destruction, and disaster.
questions.zh: ...避免飢荒、毀滅與災難的唯一機會。
questions.explain: the only chance (to avoid... disaster) 不定詞片語 ➜ 作形容詞修飾語

questions.q: ...starvation, destruction, ____ disaster.
questions.zh: ...飢荒、毀滅與災難。
questions.explain:
① 三者均有時，用 A, B, and C。
② 三者任選其一時，用 A, B, or C。
